column1: # FloatAP integer pow golden reference v1
# precision_bits mode input_num input_den exponent expected_num expected_den
# Source is the exact signed Rational supplied to the existing FloatAP constructor.
# Offline oracle FIRST rounds signed Rational input to nearest-even at precision_bits.
# It then computes the exact integer power of the rounded dyadic,
# and finally rounds ONCE at the same precision in the requested mode.
# This preserves the original input list and its 0^0 = +1 behavior.
# Signed-zero behavior is checked separately using dedicated assertions.
# Derived solely by signed arbitrary-precision integer division and exponentiation;
# no FloatAP, independent exact arithmetic, GMP, independent exact arithmetic, or floating-point rounding invoked.
# Four modes: N nearest even, D downward, U upward, Z toward zero.
# 5 bit widths x 8 magnitudes x 2 signs x 8 powers x 4 modes = 2560
# exercised cases, 2400 distinct reference keys (negative and positive zero merge).
